parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human pyruvate kinase PKM (CHEMBL1075189). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target CHEMBL ID. Filter assays for organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Alias the molecule identifier as compound_chembl_id. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
